nodes.description: mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _totalSupply; per-token-id minted supply, mutated in _beforeTokenTransfer on mint and burn paths.
ERC1155ProjectImpl.initialize(), external initializer guarded by the initializer modifier; delegates to _initialize.
ERC1155ProjectUpgradeable._initialize(), internal initializer wiring AdminControl, ERC1155, ProjectCore and UUPS initializers.
_beforeTokenTransfer hook that updates _totalSupply for mints/burns and calls _approveTransfer for every transfer.
adminMintBatch(address[],uint256[],uint256[],bytes) external nonReentrant adminRequired; sets _tokensManager and batch mints.
managerMintBatch(...) external nonReentrant managerRequired; records _msgSender() as token manager and batch mints.
burn(address,uint256[],uint256[],bytes) public nonReentrant; authorizes caller, burns single or batch and calls back _postBurn.
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom; checks owner/operator approval via isApprovedForAll and delegates to _safeTransferFrom.
ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom; checks owner/operator approval and delegates to _safeBatchTransferFrom.
_safeTransferFrom internal; updates _balances with unchecked subtraction then performs receiver acceptance check.
_safeBatchTransferFrom internal; loops over ids/amounts updating _balances and then performs batch acceptance check.
_mint internal; writes _balances[id][to] and triggers receiver acceptance check.
_mintBatch internal; loops writing _balances[ids[i]][to] and triggers batch acceptance check.
_burn internal; requires balance and performs unchecked balance subtraction.
_burnBatch internal; loops with unchecked balance subtraction for each id.
_doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck; external call to IERC1155ReceiverUpgradeable.onERC1155Received on the recipient address.
_doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck; external call to IERC1155ReceiverUpgradeable.onERC1155BatchReceived on the recipient address.
_postBurn; resolves token manager from _tokensManager and calls onBurn on the manager contract if it implements the interface.
_approveTransfer; if _managerApproveTransfers[manager] is set, externally calls manager.approveTransfer and requires true.
_authorizeUpgrade(address) internal override onlyOwner; access-control gate for implementation upgrades.
UUPS upgradeTo(address) external onlyProxy; authorizes and performs implementation upgrade.
UUPS upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) external payable onlyProxy; authorizes, upgrades and delegatecalls arbitrary data.
_functionDelegateCall; performs low-level delegatecall to the new implementation with attacker-influenced data.
mapping(uint256 => address) internal _tokensManager; tracks originating manager for each token id and drives callbacks.
mapping(address => bool) internal _managerApproveTransfers; enables forcing external manager approval of transfers.
EnumerableSet.AddressSet internal _managers; registry backing the managerRequired modifier.
EnumerableSet.AddressSet internal _blacklistedManagers; blacklist checked by nonBlacklistRequired and URI resolution.
mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _balances; token balances mutated by transfer/mint/burn paths.
mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals; operator approvals used for authorization checks.
mapping(uint256 => Royalty) public royaltyMap; per-token royalty receiver and bps.
uint256 public defaultRoyaltyBPs (with defaultRoyaltyReceiver); fallback royalty configuration.
address private _owner; ownership state used by onlyOwner and isAdmin checks.
royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256) external view; computes (salePrice * bps) / 10000 from token or default royalty.
_setDefaultRoyalty internal with onlyValidRoyalty guard; admin entry point setDefaultRoyalty.
_setTokenRoyalty internal with onlyValidRoyalty guard; admin entry point setTokenRoyalty.
managerSetApproveTransfer(bool) external managerRequired; validates msg.sender interface support and toggles _managerApproveTransfers.
_msgSender() internal view returns msg.sender; indirection used throughout for caller identity.
registerManager(address,string,bool) external adminRequired nonBlacklistRequired; registers a manager in _managers.
setApprovalForAll(address,bool) public; writes _operatorApprovals for the caller.
_transferOwnership internal; writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred; reachable from the initializer.
approveAdmin(address) external onlyOwner; adds an admin to the privileged set.
untrusted input, identical to msg.sender; used for authorization, manager identity and ownership checks.
High-level external call to untrusted recipient via IERC1155ReceiverUpgradeable acceptance check; state already updated, reentrancy surface.
External callback IERC1155ProjectBurnableManager(manager).onBurn into a manager-controlled contract during burn.
External callback IERC1155ProjectApproveTransferManager(manager).approveTransfer executed on every transfer when enabled.
Low-level delegatecall to the new implementation address with supplied data inside _functionDelegateCall.
unchecked { _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount; } and _totalSupply subtraction sites (arithmetic risk).
ERC165CheckerUpgradeable staticcall with 30000 gas to an arbitrary address to probe interface support.
setContractURI(string) external adminRequired; stores contract-level metadata URI.
managerSetTokenURI overloads external managerRequired; write token URIs after verifying _tokensManager ownership.
_upgradeToAndCallUUPS; validates proxiableUUID via external call then sets implementation and delegatecalls setup data.
address newImplementation parameter of upgradeTo / upgradeToAndCall / _authorizeUpgrade.
bytes memory data parameter executed via delegatecall after an upgrade.
address to recipient/target used for balance credit and external acceptance calls.
address manager parameter used for registration, blacklisting and callback targeting.
address account parameter of burn, checked against _msgSender() and approvals.
uint256[] tokenIds parameter iterated in mint/burn/transfer hooks.
uint256[] amounts parameter applied to balances and _totalSupply.
uint256 _salePrice parameter of royaltyInfo used in royalty arithmetic.
uint256 _royaltyBPs parameter validated by onlyValidRoyalty (<= 10000).

uint256 fromBalance local read from _balances and used in unchecked subtraction.
bytes4 response returned by the external ERC1155 receiver acceptance check.
bool success returned by the low-level delegatecall in _functionDelegateCall.

normalization_plan.reason: Upgrade target is only meaningful through the access-controlled _authorizeUpgrade gate; collapse into it.
Setup calldata is consumed only by the delegatecall, so fold into that unsafe operation.
Recipient address solely determines the external acceptance-call target; fold into the callback site.
Manager address is resolved from _tokensManager and drives the onBurn callback; fold into _postBurn.
Burn account is only used for the authorization guard inside burn; fold into the burn entry point.
Token id array is iterated to mutate _totalSupply in the hook; fold into the hook.
Amounts array is applied to _totalSupply in the hook; fold into the hook.
Sale price is only used in the royalty arithmetic of royaltyInfo; fold into that view function.
Royalty bps is validated and stored by the royalty setters; fold into the setter.
Operator local is a purely internal alias of _msgSender within _safeTransferFrom; fold into that function.
fromBalance exists only to feed the unchecked subtraction site; fold into that unsafe operation.
Returned selector is only compared inside the acceptance check; fold into that call site.
Delegatecall success flag is only used for revert bubbling; fold into the delegatecall operation.
